第九章除了闹还会什么

当天夜里，闫家当家的人都坐在主屋里商谈。

“爸，我去见郑启了，此人有正义感，但这些年日子都不好过，我背了些粮食过去他接受了。”

“很好，接受就是愿意帮咱盯着，以后一定要好好维系关系，粮食家里不够去黑市买也给送。”

“他说领导并没有发话，目前还在按章办事。只是······”

闫解放却有些欲言又止，对于去见的另外一个人有些难堪。

“怎么了，还有什么事没说？”

“就是县里那人，说调查顾城简单，就是近期他想往上调调，问咱能不能给准备一根百年人参。”

闫爷爷被气笑了，那人之前可是欠了闫家一条命，现在爬上去了却想闫家一直当金库，做梦。

“咱可是小门小户，这辈子都没见过人参，还是让他另找他人吧。

解放，你经常去县里开会，是时候再接触接触别的领导了。”

“明白，没了那人还有别人，总会找到的。”

闫嫣在一旁听着很是明白普通人真正要办事很艰难，有时候拿着钱都无处塞，求助无门很现实。

爸妈和她在前世都是大学生，在这个世界绝不能荒废下去，靠人不如靠己，和顾城的纠缠也不是一时半会就能解决的。

人家是有“剧情”光环的主角，开局有些小困难不代表往后的路走不下去，闫嫣也没那个自信和本事能一次把人给按死。

所以，双方都成长，但顾城的前路一定会时不时出现阻碍。

“三子传话说顾城去了武装部，出来时脸色难看，然后就带着俩孩子去住了招待所。”

打媳妇害人流产这件事放在哪个时代都会影响仕途，闫和平不信武装部的人会插手。

“只要顾老太婆能从派出所出来，当天咱就去武装部门口伸冤，然后再去县单位喊冤，既然想帮顾城那就要帮到底。”

“对，县里闹完得不到应有的追责，那咱就去一趟市里。就不信害死人还能不了了之。”

这年头说真的，谁都怕被告，有谁能真心为顾城铤而走险。

其实闫家人没猜错，顾城正躺在招待所床上发呆，去了武装部还没说几句就被骂了出来。

说他在即将出任务时惹出这种丧良心的事，还想拉武装部下水，直接让他滚，上面会给处理结果。

Chapter 9 What else can there be besides making trouble?

That night, the heads of the Yan family sat in the main room to discuss.

"Dad, I went to see Zheng Qi. This man has a sense of justice, but life has been difficult these years. I carried some food and he accepted it."

"Very good. If you accept it, you are willing to help us keep an eye on it. We must maintain the relationship well in the future. If we don't have enough food, we can buy it on the black market and give it away."

"He said that the leader has not spoken and is still doing things according to the rules. It's just..."

Yan Jiefang hesitated to speak, feeling a little embarrassed about the other person he was meeting.

"What's wrong? Is there anything else you haven't said?"

"That person from the county said it was easy to investigate Gu Cheng, but he wants to increase the number in the near future and asked if we could prepare a century-old ginseng."

Grandpa Yan laughed angrily. That man owed his life to the Yan family before, but now he climbed up and dreamed that the Yan family would always be used as a treasury.

“We are a small family, and we have never seen ginseng in our lives, so let him find someone else.

Jiefang, you often go to the county for meetings, it’s time to get in touch with other leaders."

"Understand, if that person is gone, there will be someone else, and they will always be found."

Listening on the sidelines, Yan Yan understood that it was very difficult for ordinary people to get things done. Sometimes, it was very realistic that they had nowhere to go with their money and no way to ask for help.

Her parents and she were both college students in their previous lives, and they must not be left idle in this world. It is better to rely on others than to rely on yourself, and the entanglement with Gu Cheng cannot be resolved in a short while.

He is the protagonist with a "plot" aura. A few difficulties at the beginning does not mean that he will not be able to go on in the future. Yan Yan does not have the confidence or ability to kill someone in one go.

Therefore, both sides have grown, but Gu Cheng's path forward will definitely encounter obstacles from time to time.

"The third son sent word that Gu Cheng had gone to the Armed Forces Ministry. His face was ugly when he came out, and then he took the two children to stay in a guest house."

Beating one's wife and causing miscarriage would affect one's official career in any era. Yan Heping did not believe that people from the Armed Forces would interfere.

"As long as Mrs. Gu can come out of the police station, we will go to the armed department to redress her grievances that day, and then go to the county unit to redress her grievances. If we want to help Gu Cheng, we must help her to the end."

"Yes, if the county can't get the proper accountability after the trouble, let's go to the city. I don't believe that killing people can be ignored."

To be honest these days, everyone is afraid of being accused, and who can really take risks for Gu Cheng's desperation?

In fact, the Yan family guessed right. Gu Cheng was lying on the bed in the guest house in a daze. He went to the Armed Forces Ministry and was scolded before even saying a few words.

He said that he caused such a shameful thing when he was about to go on a mission, and wanted to drag the armed forces into trouble. He just told him to get out, and the superiors would deal with the consequences.
